race.comment: SOUTHERN HEIRESS (14) gets the nod third-up after two solid Doomben runs behind Speithtacular. Should be hitting her straps now and will will get a lovely look from the inside pillar. Expect her to prove hard to hold out under the light weight. HIGHGROVE ROSE (15) resumes off two trials and was last sighted finishing off strongly into midfield in G1 Queensland Oaks back in June. Draws well and this looks like a good starting point for her. BIANCELLI (4) is another of the main contenders, having won here two back before missing by just over half a length at Doomben, where she had a minor hampering issue. HE'S TRU BLUE (13) is also knocking on the door after a half-length BM70 second as favourite and now gets first-time blinkers with weight relief. POCKETMONEY (11) is another that is knocking on the door and deserves respect.
